sentence: This project tries to find human T cell genes and molecules that suppress antitumor T cell responses against cancer cells.
This project builds a dietary logging system that uses computer vision and deep learning to predict the nutritional content of a meal from a photo.
This project develops a long-acting form of a drug that improves immune responses, aiming to treat acute myeloid leukemia.
This project studies how a gene linked to DNA methylation changes affects cellular and behavioral responses to cocaine.
This project studies inhibitory signals in chimeric antigen receptor T cells to design versions for acute myeloid leukemia that spare healthy tissues.
This project builds mouse models with large chromosomal deletions to study how these deletions drive prostate cancer.
This project tests whether multi-omic approaches can improve precision medicine in chronic kidney disease care.
This project studies malaria mosquitoes, their insecticide resistance, and how they transmit parasites across different ecological zones.
This project tries to find new factors involved in how proinflammatory cytokines inhibit cellular signaling.
This project builds a platform to find and block microRNA interactions with genes linked to neurodevelopmental disorders in human neurons.
This project brings emerging technologies into research on reproductive biology.
This project tests magnetic resonance imaging tools, the central vein sign and the paramagnetic rim, to diagnose multiple sclerosis more accurately.
This project studies how selenium metabolism helps acute myeloid leukemia cells avoid cell death, using animal models and patient samples.
This project builds a low-cost test that detects viral RNA from hepatitis C virus and human immunodeficiency virus in whole blood.
This project tries to find brain pathways involved in persistent post-surgical pain and opioid dependence.
This project supports an annual scientific conference where cancer surveillance professionals share research findings.
This project builds microfluidic tools to study how human immune cells, fibroblasts, and microbes send chemical signals in inflammation.
This project tries to find which glycans influenza viruses need to infect different hosts and builds a platform to identify zoonotic strains.
This project studies how basal cell plasticity in prostatitis links prostatitis to prostate cancer.
This project tries to find out how an immunosuppression environment in the tumor-draining lymph node restricts stem-like precursors that respond to cancer immunotherapy.
